newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia April 1-25 palm oil exports 549,976t - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia April 1-25 palm oil exports 549,976t - SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said on Friday it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for April 1-25 at 549,976 tonnes against 510,908 tonnes in March 1-25.
It said the exports comprised 168,574 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 210,847 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 48,500 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products totalled 122,055 tonnes.
Pakistan was the top buyer during the period, taking 91,550 tonnes, followed by India which bought 78,670 tonnes, China (75,676 tonnes), Turkey (28,850 tonnes) and South Africa (24,155 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 71,847 tonnes.
